restaurantName: Mi Yuan Tzu Steamed Glutinous Rice
address: 30 Nanhai Street, Sinsing District, Kaohsiung, Taiwan
bio: After selling sticky rice in a market for 10-plus years, the owner couple opened this shop in 2021. Tables are set on a plant-adorned porch with tiled floor and walls; the cartoon duck and handwritten logo create a strong visual identity. The signature boneless duck sticky rice entices with its sesame oil and ginger aromas, while taro pork rib soup boasts starchy tuber infused with meaty flavours. Honey black tea from Taitung makes the perfect pairing.
pageTitle: Mi Yuan Tzu Steamed Glutinous Rice
